desc:
New adventures unfold in the newly expanded Maretime Bay! The magical racetrack minigame brings a fresh course every single round with new twists, turns and playful obstacles that keep every race exciting and full of surprises!

At the racetrack you can compete with Everypony in vehicles, on skates and even in the hot air balloons!
Will you be crowned the fastest pony in town?

ADDED:
🏁 Racetrack Minigame in Maretime Bay!

🌠 Hourly Crystal Shower World Event on 00:00 minute mark!
